clips.title: The story
paras: At Zoram'gar Outpost, Je'neu Sancrea watches the Ashenvale coast for dark disturbances. The Darkspear troll and Earthen Ring shaman sends Horde adventurers to investigate corruption in the submerged temple of Blackfathom Deeps.

Je'neu Sancrea watches the dangerous Zoram Strand from Zoram'gar Outpost. While most of the Earthen Ring works to keep the elements in harmony across Kalimdor, he keeps watch over the coast. Dark tremors and unnatural tides stir near the ruined temple of Blackfathom Deeps. His shamanic duties bind him to the Earthen Ring, but his loyalties to the Darkspear tribe and Thrall's Horde lead him to work only with Horde champions.
